blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Retired Chief Justice Artemio Panganiban told the Senate impeachment court on Wednesday that the Supreme Court (SC) could not decide on the impeachment voting threshold on Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial where three senator-judges have been absent from all proceedings thus far. This comes after Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo asked the amici curiae on whether or not the conviction threshold must be decided by the high court or the senator-judges themselves. “You are an independent, free court… The Constitution says the Senate shall be the sole judge, to try and decide impeachment cases… You, as elected officials of the […]...
